{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Exclude rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df_dedup[df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 3: Compute the mean baseline biomarker value (already in ng/mL)
mean_baseline = df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print result
mean_baseline"}
